title: A second factor enrolled outside a live invitation (ADR 0088 D3, D4)
assertion: An unknown, active, enrolled, locked, disabled or lapsed-invitation account answered `MFA_SETUP` is refused before any enrolment call, at the challenge and again before associate and verify, Cognito stores nothing, and a security event is logged; the account is the one matched by both the enrolling Cognito subject and the email, so a row whose `cognito_sub` differs from the subject, a challenge with no subject, or email and sub rows that are different users are refused; an invited, unexpired, unenrolled account enrols; an invitation onto a Cognito user that has signed in is refused, and onto one that never has re-sends its temporary password
noFileReason: Synthetic invited, active, enrolled, locked and orphan personas answer the enrolment challenge through the local identity provider and the Cognito twin; no file.
